en: An old, colorized postcard showing a street scene with several people in historical dress. The focal point is a partly ruined Gothic-style palace overgrown with ivy. The palace facade features pointed arches and decorative stonework. The top of the postcard has printed text reading 'Rusevine Palace Leporini.' The surroundings are narrow stone streets and buildings typical of Mediterranean historical cities.
